description: Independent reference (LPC.PC.21a) for the import graph built by tools/test_impact.py. Derived by hand by the planner (claude-opus-5-5, WU-0011.2, 2026-10-10) from the import statements of lpcstudy/*.py, including function-level imports and 'from . import x', before the tool existed. Key: module stem; value: sorted lpcstudy modules it imports directly, at any scope. Update by hand in the same change as any import edit; never from tool output. 2026-10-10 (WU-0001, developer claude-sonnet-5-5): the seeds and provenance rows and the changed __main__ edges (seeds, provenance) were added by hand from the import statements in WU-0001.1 and .4; source_commit is the commit at which the graph was last checked against the imports (ed6dacb, WU-0001.4). 2026-10-10 (WU-0002.2, developer claude-sonnet-5-5): the identifiers row (no imports) was added by hand with lpcstudy/identifiers.py, and the analysis, experiments and report edges to identifiers by hand with the imports (WU-0002.2); source_commit is the commit that added the identifiers row, checked against the imports of the following commit by reading them. 2026-10-11 (WU-0002.4-5 phase 2, developer claude-sonnet-5-5): the edge analysis -> data was added by hand with the import of make_rng in lpcstudy/analysis.py (H1a, H1b and H1d bootstraps, DEC-0012); no module was added, so the module count is unchanged; source_commit is unchanged and the edge was checked by reading the import line.
